bearerAuth.description: Locally issued opaque workspace-scoped token; constant-time comparison; never URL/query token.

classifier.description: Persisted advisory-classifier audit (BH-021); null when no gate was attached or the stored audit no longer decodes. Unknown cost is null while cost_known is false, never zero (OD-07).

attached.description: True when a gate was attached, so zero calls is a fact rather than absent instrumentation.

availability.description: Verdict counts keyed by availability: available, disabled, unreachable, timeout, unauthorized, rate_limited, invalid_response, service_error.
